description: Correlate an X (Twitter) post to a memecoin price impact. Fetches post metadata via oEmbed (no API key) and computes price delta from the pump.fun bonding curve in a ±windowMin window around the post. Use this to measure how one X post moved a coin that is still on its bonding curve (pricing is virtual_quote_reserves / virtual_token_reserves); a graduated coin has no curve, so the call fails rather than returning a zero price.

windowMin.description: ±window in minutes around the post time

name: social_x_post_impact
title: X Post Price Impact
